patterns: APPSC asks AP district/ISFR facts: district with highest forest cover (East Godavari, ISFR 2019), AP fire-affected area 2023-24 (5,286.76 sq km)
Endemic species (red sanders) and Seshachalam = dry deciduous are recurring single-fact items
APFDC plantation crops (eucalyptus largest) and India's 3rd rank in forest-area gain appear
Other PSCs ask all-India forest-type/location matches (Sundarbans, Silent Valley, khair-catechu)
Trap: forest cover (ISFR area) vs recorded forest area (Kadapa) vs percentage - app mixes these
